def load():

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

def solve(inp):
    res=[]
    for i in range(len(inp)//3):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(inp[0])//3):

            cc=Counter(vals); lc,lcnt=cc.most_common(1)[0]  # local bg

    return G

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(inp,N=None):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # noise: if provided use it; else most common non-bg color
    ncol=N if N is not None else [v for v,c in cnt.most_common() if v!=bg][0]
    out=[]
    for i in range(H//3):
        row=[]
        for j in range(W//3):
            vals=[[inp[i*3+r][j*3+c] for c in range(3)] for r in range(3)]
            nb=[v for r in range(3) for c in range(3) for v in [vals[r][c]] if v not in (bg,ncol)]
            cc=Counter(nb)
            pred=cc.most_common(1)[0][0] if nb else bg
            row.append(pred)
        out.append(row)
    return out
